items.title_kr: 메이시스, 제100회 추수감사절 퍼레이드용 '마법사의 제자 미키' 벌룬 공개
items.title_en: Sorcerer’s Apprentice Mickey Balloon Debuts for Macy’s 100th Parade
items.body_kr: 메이시스는 제100회 추수감사절 퍼레이드를 기념하여 '마법사의 제자 미키' 캐릭터 풍선과 홀리데이 디즈니 캡슐 컬렉션을 선보였습니다. 대형 이벤트와 독점 캐릭터 협업은 연말 시즌 트래픽을 유도하는 핵심 프로모션 요소입니다.
items.body_en: Macy's unveiled a Sorcerer's Apprentice Mickey balloon and holiday Disney capsule collection for its 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade. Major experiential events and exclusive character collaborations serve as critical traffic-driving promotions for the holiday season.

items.title_kr: 메이시스, 50달러부터 시작하는 가을 패션 트렌드 아이템 조명
items.title_en: The best fall fashion is hiding at Macy’s (and in my cart): 13 picks starting at $50
items.body_kr: Macy's is highlighting a curated selection of fall fashion essentials starting at an accessible $50 price point. Vendors should align seasonal transitional apparel and value-driven sourcing strategies with these early autumn merchandising pushes.

items.title_kr: 콜스, 넷플릭스 'KPop Demon Hunters' 영감 받은 대규모 컬렉션 출시
items.title_en: Kohl's Introduces New Collection Inspired By Netflix’s KPop Demon Hunters
items.body_kr: Kohl's has launched an extensive new apparel and merchandise collection inspired by Netflix's 'KPop Demon Hunters'. Collaborating with popular streaming IPs serves as a key differentiation strategy to capture youth demographic demand during the back-to-school season.

items.title_kr: 홀리스타, 북아일랜드 더 불바드에 두 번째 매장 오픈 확정
items.title_en: The Boulevard confirms opening of Hollister's second Northern Irish store with teaser video
items.body_kr: Hollister has officially confirmed the upcoming opening of its second Northern Irish store at The Boulevard via a teaser video. This physical footprint expansion reinforces the brand's localized retail presence targeting Gen Z consumers.

items.title_kr: 바클레이즈, 관세 전망 개선 반영해 아베크롬비앤피치(A&F) 주가 등급 상향
items.title_en: Barclays upgrades Abercrombie & Fitch stock rating on tariff outlook By Investing.com
items.body_kr: Barclays has upgraded Abercrombie & Fitch's stock rating, citing improved tariff outlooks and robust brand positioning. This institutional vote of confidence signals strong margin resilience and supply chain stability for key vendor partners.
